title: Phishing report triage
description: Triage emails that staff at Larkfield Analytics (a fictional company, domain larkfield.example) reported with the 'Report phishing' button. Decide whether each is phishing, what kind of lure it uses, and how much harm acting on it could cause. All emails, people and domains are fictional.

questions.instructions: This email is a phishing or fraud attempt rather than a genuine message.

criteria.true: Tries to trick the recipient into giving credentials or money, opening malware, or acting on a false request, typically from a lookalike or unexpected sender.
criteria.false: A genuine message from the sender it claims to be, even if it is urgent, unwanted marketing or about security.

questions.instructions: What does the email try to get the recipient to do?

criteria.credential_harvest: Enter a password, login or card details on a page it links to or attaches.
criteria.invoice_fraud: Pay an invoice or change a supplier's bank details so money goes to the attacker.
criteria.malware_attachment: Open an attachment that runs code, such as a zip, macro-enabled document or executable.
criteria.gift_card: Buy gift cards or vouchers and send the codes.

questions.instructions: How much harm could the company suffer if the recipient did what the email asks?

levels.text: Low: no realistic harm; genuine email or harmless spam.
Medium: limited loss, such as a small payment or one person's personal card details.
High: company credentials, company money, or malware on a company machine.
